//: Per-zone client-bundle ceilings in gzipped KB, over every .js/.css under .svelte-kit/output/client. A zone boundary is a full document load, so the bundle behind it is the whole cost of crossing one — and with the zones deployable on their own tags nobody watches all four at once. Raise a number ONLY with the reason in the commit message; that edit is the review.

home.note: The landing + the OIDC round-trip. Should stay the smallest thing in the estate; if it grows, something that belongs in a domain zone has leaked into the shell.

lakehouse.note: Four areas (catalog, lineage, models, admin) in one router. Carries @xyflow/svelte for the lineage graph and layerchart for the model experiments.

media.note: embedding-atlas + d3 + elkjs for the atlas/tree/graph surfaces.

annotator.note: Pixi + the vendored OpenCV wasm. This number is the entire reason the annotator is a zone of its own rather than an area of media: the split keeps it out of a searcher's bundle. If it ever approaches media's, the split has stopped paying for itself.
